Cites: [{value} +], [{raw}], and [\{value}].

Target.

  • [entry +] Attribute entry.
  • [+++<mark>raw</mark>+++] Attribute markup.
  • [Target label +] Linked entry.
  • [entry] Passthrough entry.
  • [] Empty entry.
  • [before {missing} after] Missing attribute.
  • [{value}] Escaped attribute.

After: after.
